tools.name: readit_guide_load
tools.description: Load an entire prepared tour atomically. Next/back run locally without AI. Provide overview to open a native overview tab before code. Read all source first. Step events are informational, not requests to generate another explanation. A prediction step keeps Next disabled until the reader records a prediction or chooses unknown; that happens locally and emits a prediction event, not a request for an answer.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

kind.description: Optional, default explanation. hypothesis: a claim the reader checks in later code. prediction: the reader records what they expect before reading on; requires prompt. verification: shows the reader's earlier prediction next to this code; requires verifies.

prompt.description: prediction only: the question the reader answers, max 2000 characters.

verifies.description: verification only: id of an earlier prediction step in the same tour.

tools.name: readit_guide_revise
tools.description: Answer a pending tour question and atomically replace all unread steps after visited_through, when the question changes what the rest of the route should cover. When the prepared steps still fit, answer with readit_guide_answer instead and keep them. Preserve visited history and current position. Read state/events first; reject stale navigation or ended tours. Existing steps remain usable while generating. An empty steps array ends the route after visited history.

tools.name: readit_pin
tools.description: Keep a read-only snapshot of related code beside the main editor without changing its active file or cursor. Includes unsaved text. One pinned file at a time; another pin replaces it. Re-pin to refresh after edits.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, absolute open-file path, or definition path returned by readit_symbol.

tools.name: readit_unpin
tools.description: Close the pinned code view, preserving the main editor.

tools.name: readit_guide_show
tools.description: Show a short explanation anchored to exact source text and select it. User buttons produce events. Read events before continuing; end/interrupted means stop unless user asks to resume.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, absolute open-file path, or definition path returned by readit_symbol.

expected_text.description: Exact nonempty source text to highlight, at most 16000 characters. Rejects stale code.

event_sequence.description: Latest guide_event_sequence from state or latest_sequence from events.

tools.name: readit_guide_events
tools.description: Read user responses after a sequence number. Actions: next, question, end, interrupted, cleared. Question events include user text, source range, exact code, current explanation and previous Q&A. Answer using readit_guide_answer without advancing the guide. Non-consuming; store latest_sequence. If truncated, stop and inspect state. Poll while actively guiding, not indefinitely after end.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

tools.name: readit_guide_answer
tools.description: Answer a pending user question in the existing bubble, in a prepared tour or a single explanation. Preserves the question, source location, guide step and the remaining tour steps. Rejects responses after end, source changes or a different question. Do not substitute a canned explanation for the user question.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

id.description: Step id from the question event.

body.description: Answer to the actual question, plain text, at most 4000 characters.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

tools.name: readit_state
tools.description: Inspect the visible Readit window, cursor, selection, tabs, unsaved flags and viewport. Start here.

tools.name: readit_open_folder
tools.description: Open a folder as the Readit workspace in the current window, like an IDE's open folder. Use it when the code to read is outside the opened folder. Replaces the project, tabs and any tour; unsaved edits make Readit ask the user to save or discard first. Starts Readit on this folder if it is not running yet. Returns the new state; pass its workspace to later tools.

path.description: Folder to open: absolute, or relative to this MCP server's working directory.

tools.name: readit_files
tools.description: List the editor's workspace text files; paginate with next_offset. Does not navigate the UI.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

tools.name: readit_read
tools.description: Read current text, including unsaved edits. Use small ranges; does not change the visible file.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, absolute open-file path, or definition path returned by readit_symbol.

numbered.description: Prefix each line with its one-based number, as 'NNN| text', to anchor steps without counting.

tools.name: readit_search
tools.description: Find literal occurrences in current workspace text, including unsaved edits. Use readit_symbol for semantic references.

workspace.description: Exact workspace path returned by readit_state. Prevents controlling a different project.

prefix.description: Optional workspace-relative path prefix, such as web/app/ or tools/, to search only that part of the project.

tools.name: readit_open
tools.description: Show a file at a line and select an optional [start,end) range so the user can follow. Preserves unsaved buffers and records navigation history.
